mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust economic activity that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase, or interaction term regression coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher interest rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer credit growth (RSAFS) exceeding 3.5% year-over-year signals strong spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in consumer credit (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates sustained demand growth that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises over three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term regression coefficient is negative with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
